# Microsoft Graph Bicep Extension (beta)

## About

The Microsoft Graph Bicep extension allows you to define the tenant infrastructure you want to deploy, such as Microsoft Entra groups or applications, in a file, then use the file throughout the development lifecycle to repeatedly deploy your infrastructure. The file uses the [Bicep](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-resource-manager/bicep/overview) language, a domain-specific language (DSL) that uses declarative syntax to deploy resources, typically for your [infrastructure as code](https://learn.microsoft.com/devops/deliver/what-is-infrastructure-as-code) solutions.

This repo contains the Microsoft Graph Bicep extension for the Microsoft Graph API beta version. To learn about the Microsoft Graph Bicep extension, see [Bicep templates for Microsoft Graph resources](https://aka.ms/graphbicep).

## Usage

The artifact, when referenced and imported in Bicep files, allows you to define Microsoft Graph beta resources that can be declared in the Bicep files. For more information, see [Microsoft Graph Bicep dynamic types](https://aka.ms/graphBicepDynamicTypes).

> NOTE: `docker pull` will not work for Microsoft Graph Bicep extension artifacts. Use `oras pull` if you want to get the artifacts on your local machine.

## Support

You can find more information [Bicep templates for Microsoft Graph resources public documentation](https://aka.ms/graphbicep).

If you have any problems with or questions about using Microsoft Graph Bicep extension, contact us through a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/microsoftgraph/msgraph-bicep-types/issues).

## Feedback

Provide feedback through a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/microsoftgraph/msgraph-bicep-types/issues).
